But--</hi>contrasting, cast off as abhorrent (<reference osisRef="Ps.43.2">Psa 43:2</reference>).<div eID="gen9093" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen9094" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">goest not forth--</hi>literally, "will not go" (<reference osisRef="2Sam.5.23">2Sa 5:23</reference>).
